component.name: Artemis
component.summary: Stream games and other applications from another PC running Sunshine or GeForce Experience

description.p: Artemis can stream games and other applications from another PC with Sunshine or GeForce Experience software installed.

ul.li: Hardware accelerated video decoding with VAAPI, VDPAU, and Vulkan Video support
H.264, HEVC, and AV1 codec support
Gamepad support with force feedback for up to 16 players
Support for both pointer capture (for games) and direct mouse control (for remote desktop)
Support for passing system-wide keyboard shortcuts like Alt+Tab to the host

screenshot.caption: Host selection page showing local PCs

description.p: The stream window and its audio now identify as Artemis (app ID com.artemis_desktop.Artemis), so compositor window rules can match them. OTP pairing with Apollo hosts verifies the host the same way PIN pairing does, and works from the command line with --passphrase. A custom refresh rate such as 59.94 Hz stays set and streams at the right frame rate, and the renderer list only offers choices the build supports. An oversized host clipboard is abandoned instead of stalling sync. The quick menu (Ctrl+Alt+Shift+\) is drawn inside the stream, so it works over a fullscreen stream, and shows the results of its actions.

Brings in moonlight-qt 6.2.0 and its later fixes. The quick menu no longer crashes during a stream, clipboard sync with Apollo hosts works on Wayland, and command-line on/off options such as --hdr take effect again.
